scope: Investigated five HeyCatch recommendations; approved fixes included in the combined QNT reliability release. HeyCatch recommendations were not marked completed.

findings.result: Historical failure not confirmed; missing recovery and bounded UI waits confirmed in code.
evidence: Live Google start endpoint returns accounts.google.com, response_type=code, configured client ID and state, and https://app.walnutmarkets.com/auth/google/callback.
Backend token exchange has a 20-second timeout and logs rejection reasons; frontend callback previously had no deadline and only a generic Continue link.
Nine existing backend Google tests passed, including callback/session-cookie behavior. No real user was signed out, registered, or charged for testing.
changes: Google start waits at most 15 seconds, callback completion 45 seconds, and session verification 15 seconds.
Cancelled or failed callbacks display a retry link to login; the requested safe app destination is retained in session storage and after callback success.
OAuth query parameters are removed from the visible callback URL, and no automatic code replay is attempted.
Successful navigation still requires a verified authenticated session.
findings.limitation: These checks do not establish why the specific historical visitor stopped. No historical session replay or matching failure log was available from the recommendation itself.

findings.result: Works in current production; confusing retained list-scroll position confirmed in code.
findings.evidence: Live Next changed page 1 of 448 to page 2 of 448 with different alerts.
findings.changes: Reset the inbox list scroll on pagination/filter changes; announce page number and visible update range.

findings.result: Clears selected checkboxes in production; it does not reset filters, contrary to HeyCatch's interpretation.
findings.evidence: Live Select all visible checked five alerts; Clear selection unchecked all five and returned the count to zero. No alerts were marked read or deleted.
findings.changes: Disable Clear selection at zero selections, clarify its purpose, announce the selection count, disable Select all visible on an empty page, and provide a separate Reset filters button when filters are active.

findings.result: Current Analyze a Stock form opened NVDA successfully in production. Missing native form fallback and blank-query behavior were confirmed in code.
findings.changes: Add a native GET action to the app search route with a named required query input, preserve the existing suggestion navigation, add blank/whitespace validation and pending feedback, restore submission state on browser back, and isolate search tracking exceptions. Allow the exact app origin in form-action CSP for the cross-host fallback.
findings.limitation: The native fallback submits to the search page; that page still uses JavaScript to fetch search results. The six historical homepage-only sessions were not reproduced.

findings.result: Not reproduced; no automatic document reload or index/detail redirect cycle found in this flow.
evidence: Live index loaded and a saved Research Memory opened successfully and remained on its detail route.
The index refreshes its data API every 60 seconds and on focus, without navigation.
The detail's explicit Activate action performs one document reload after success; it is not a timer.
PageAnalyticsTracker is driven by route/query/consent changes, not the research data-refresh timer.
findings.changes: None. Repeated visits alone do not prove an automatic reload loop.

validation.production_build: Passed: Next.js compilation, type checking, and static generation.
validation.frontend: 54 tests run: 50 passed, 4 failed. The same four failures reproduced against unchanged HEAD sources; all nine new behavioral tests passed.
validation.local_browser: Built callback cancellation showed a visible retry link, scrubbed query parameters, and opened login. Empty and whitespace-only homepage submissions showed validation and stayed on the page.
preexisting_test_failures: visible feed results load client-side with bounded gain/loss enrichment
feed list defaults to compact table while preserving card view
watchlist activity unlocks premium metrics for entitled users
monitoring source cards share styling and make whole source rows clickable
